about_the_game:
The Pre-Order Bonus Pack contains costumes and attachments for Alphen and Shionne, exclusive recipes, and food.

Content includes:
• Alphen
- [Costume] Reconciler Armor

• Shionne
- [Costume] Noble Ash
- [Hairstyle] Void Black Tiara

• Attachments
- Left Black Wing
- Right Black Wing
- Left White Wing
- Right White Wing

• Exclusive Cooking Recipes
- Mabo Curry Bun Recipe
- Fisherman's Hot Pot Recipe
- Eastern Rice Recipe
- Fruit Sandwich Recipe

• Food
- Wheat x2
- Pork x2
- Tofu x2
- Pepper x2
- Salmon x1
- Mackerel x1
- Mushroom x1
- Rice x1
- Egg x1
- Strawberry x1
- Lemon x1
- Milk x1

*This content will be available in-game after claiming it from the in-game Unclaimed DLC List.
